profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CoreLogic
profile.summary: Tony is a Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of software development experience. He is passionate about technology from web and api application development to smart home automation. He has experience using .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC (web/API), WPF.  He also has experience using several javascript libraries and frameworks such as VueJS, AngularJS, NodeJS and Backbone. As well as module bundlers such as Webpack and RequireJS. He has experience with Azure, specifically around eventing, EventGrids, Azure Functions and SignalR

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using KendoUI, Dotnet core, Entity Framework, ASP.NET MVC4, Azure Functions, Azure Queues, Azure EventGrids to satisfy Product requests.

Created frontend pages for FellowshipOne Portal in KendoUI and MVC in .NET 4.7.2 which talked to DOTNETCORE, entity framework backend.

Created Azure Queue and Azure Function for background processing for integration into a third party vendor. A web request adds an item to a queue that triggers an Azure Function that calls out to an API for data and processes the item. 

Created the Azure Queue and Azure function to handle the delivery of emails for the Portal App using SendGrid.

Created EventGrid subscriptions to handle security events that occurred in the Portal App.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
On a team of 5 developers to rewrite a legacy VB6 application on .NET I created a tool to spin through two reports in CSV to find out which columns to use to sort on. These columns are then used to to compare the two reports, moving away from a manual and tedious process to an automated process.
Created tools to run reports against a reporting API to be used in comparison.
Developed Unit tests and Integration Tests
Technologies and Tools: VS 2017, C#, SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected a WPF Application for Michaels’ to be used in their custom framing factories. Developed UI and View Models using the MVVM pattern.
I met with Business stakeholder to gather requirements 
Technologies and Tools: VS 2015, C#, WPF, XAML, MVVM Lite

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a team of eight to create the next version of wearable cameras for Law Enforcement Agencies
I worked on their “Enhanced Video Playback” experience for Evidence Management using WPF and ReactiveUI by providing a 2-Up display of recorded events.
Created a tool to migrate application settings from Windows Registry to AppData
I wrote the client-side role authorization for their roles
Used KnockoutJS and DurandalJS to build views and custom components.
Technologies: Visual Studio, DurandalJS, KnockoutJS, WPF, ReactiveUI, SQL 2014, C#, ASP.NET MVC, WEB API, Git

positions.title: AngularJS Developer
positions.description:
As a Senior consultant I helped create Verizon Terremark’s next generation web portal, codename ‘SHIELD’, that consolidates two separate cloud service offerings into one single web portal using both AngularJS and NodeJS.  

Was heavily involved in helping Verizon Terremark’s architects create a maintainable client-side architecture. Was instrumental in helping current development staff learn and use GIT as their SCM. 

Helped the onboarding of new team members to the project. 

Had to reverse engineer both existing web applications, as the SHIELD project has no written requirements. Took mockups from UI/UX team and created client-side code using AngularJS.  

Created client-side services that seamlessly mapped both disparate backends into one unified frontend. Created directives to help realize code reuse. Used Highcharts to create resource utilization charts. Created custom HTML5 Canvas Gauge to show resource Allocation. 

Helped in project management by suggesting new process flows and tooling.

positions.title: iOS Developer / AWE iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Heavily involved in creating a TVE framework (Television Everywhere) for iOS called AWE. The AWE framework is currently being used to power network providers, allowing them to skin their brand on top of the AWE framework using their data feeds. 

Took the AWE framework and branded such channels as BRAVO, Telemundo, SYFI, USA and Sprout Networks to name a few. All featured by Apple
